items.title: Spot Natural Gas Market Splits Along Weather Lines
items.summary: Physical natural gas prices traded widely mixed Thursday for Friday flow as triple-digit heat across Texas lifted West Texas cash prices while milder conditions across portions of the East weighed on demand centers.
